description: Na₈Ti₅O₁₄ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are nine inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with eight NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.42 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.42 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.84 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra, corners with three TiO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with seven NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.50 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-25°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.41 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 21°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.58 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-14°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.56 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two NaO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.57 Å. In the ninth Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 20-22°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.54 Å. There are five inequivalent Ti sites. In the first Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-2.33 Å. In the second Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-2.37 Å. In the third Ti site, Ti is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.32 Å. In the fourth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 13-22°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.15 Å. In the fifth Ti site, Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with three NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with five NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-25°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.80-2.28 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₅Ti octahedra that share corners with three OTi₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with five ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, edges with two ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Ti atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra that share corners with two ONa₅Ti octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with four ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, edges with four ONa₄Ti square pyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-14°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₄Ti square pyramids that share corners with four ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, corners with three ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Ti square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 6-14°. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra that share corners with three ONa₄Ti square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with seven ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Ti square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Ti atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four OTi₆ octahedra, corners with three ONa₄Ti square pyramids, edges with four ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 10-20°. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to six Ti atoms to form OTi₆ octahedra that share corners with two ONa₅Ti octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Ti square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with five ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, edges with three ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids, and edges with two ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-6°. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Ti atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ti₃ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₃ octahedra, corners with two ONa₄Ti square pyramids, corners with two ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with seven ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, edges with two ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramids that share corners with four ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, corners with two ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with five OTi₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Ti₃ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-79°. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ti atom to form distorted ONa₅Ti octahedra that share corners with two OTi₆ octahedra, corners with two ONa₄Ti square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with six ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, edges with three ONa₄Ti square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, corners with three ONa₄Ti square pyramids, corners with two ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids, edges with six OTi₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 18°. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Ti atoms to form distorted ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three ONa₄Ti₂ octahedra, corners with four ONa₄Ti square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid, edges with four OTi₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Ti₂ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 19-50°.
